Those of Israelite descent separated themselves from all the foreigners, and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

verses.text: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies— and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,

xrefs.text: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is righteous.”

In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food— the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.

Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of your evil deeds.”

“Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days, but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.”

xrefs.text: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.

verses.text: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.

xrefs.text: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,
because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

verses.text: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

xrefs.text: God did not reject His people, whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah, how he appealed to God against Israel:
But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
But in Your great compassion, You did not put an end to them; nor did You forsake them, for You are a gracious and compassionate God.

But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them, and He turned toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And to this day, the LORD has been unwilling to destroy them or cast them from His presence.
But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

verses.text: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”

verses.text: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.

xrefs.text: These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai.
These are the statutes and ordinances you must be careful to follow all the days you live in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess.
These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,
You are to follow the LORD your God and fear Him. Keep His commandments and listen to His voice; serve Him and hold fast to Him.
